verdict.rationale: Firstbase advertises a compliance dashboard that shows each state's requirements and upcoming deadlines and lets founders take the needed actions, and it bundles compliance and tax into Firstbase One. That implies deadline-driven state filings, but no cited source explicitly says Firstbase files annual reports or franchise tax for the founder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that annual reports and franchise tax are filed through the platform, details on automated or done-for-you filing and on-time guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these filings.
